import os,glob,re
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G

def find_cross(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0]); marks=[(i,j,g[i][j]) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if g[i][j] not in (0,3)]
    crosses=[]
    for m in marks:
        i,j,v=m
        # bounding box of color 3 cells
        cols3=[(a,b) for a in range(H) for b in range(W) if g[a][b]==3 and abs(a-i)<=2 and abs(b-j)<=2 and g[a][b]!=v]
        xs=[b for a,b in cols3]; ys=[a for a,b in cols3]
        if len(cols3)>=4:
            h=max(ys)-min(ys)+1; w=max(xs)-min(xs)+1
            crosses.append({'pos':(i,j),'val':v,'y':min(ys),'x':min(xs),'h':h,'w':w})
    return crosses
